status_key.verified_primary: Definition taken from the RERA Act text or K-RERA documents read on 2026-10-22.
status_key.general_knowledge: Widely used industry meaning. Written from general knowledge, NOT checked against an official source. Safe for background understanding; do not state as a legal fact in a script without a check.
status_key.secondary_reported: From news or industry sources that were found but not confirmed on an official site.

terms.plain: The developer or person who builds or develops land into plots or apartments to sell them.
terms.legal: RERA Act s2(zk): a person who constructs, or develops land into a project, to sell apartments or plots.

terms.plain: The buyer to whom a plot, apartment or building has been allotted or sold.
Someone who negotiates or helps sell on behalf of others. Must register with RERA.
Developing a building or land into apartments or plots to sell them, including common areas and development works.
Anything that tells people about a project or invites them to buy or pay an advance, in any medium.
terms.legal: RERA Act s2(b): any document, notice, circular or publicity 'through any medium'.

terms.plain: A brochure or notice offering a project for sale or inviting advances.
A 2016 law that makes developers register projects, tell the truth in ads, and protects buyers' money.
terms.legal: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016; in force from 1 May 2017 per Karnataka FAQ.

terms.plain: The Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority. It registers projects and agents and hears complaints.
terms.legal: Established under s20 and the Karnataka Rules 2017; K-RERA site: rera.karnataka.gov.in.

terms.plain: The number K-RERA gives a registered project. Karnataka numbers look like PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/210113/003785.
terms.legal: Must appear in every ad: s11(2).

terms.plain: The written contract between developer and buyer. A developer cannot take more than 10% as advance without signing and registering it.
The usable floor area inside the apartment walls. It excludes external walls, service shafts, and exclusive balcony or terrace, and includes internal walls.
terms.legal: RERA Act s2(k). Under RERA, area for sale is stated as carpet area.
terms.script_note: Never quote 'super built-up area' as if it were carpet area.

terms.plain: A certificate from the competent authority that the project was built according to the sanctioned plan.
A certificate from the competent authority that permits people to occupy a building, which has civic infrastructure such as water, sanitation and electricity.
The building or layout plan approved by the competent authority. The developer must build as per it.
Permission to start construction. K-RERA says a project can be registered only after plan approval and this certificate.
A project still being built with no completion certificate, subject to listed exclusions.
terms.legal: Karnataka FAQ Q3 lists five exclusions.

terms.plain: 70% of buyers' money for a registered project is kept in a separate bank account for construction and land cost.
A judge-level officer who decides disputes about false ads (s12), changes to plans (s14), refunds (s18) and buyer duties (s19).
Interest at the State Bank of India's highest marginal cost of lending rate plus two percent, for both promoter and buyer.
A record of a property with the local body, used for property tax. In Bengaluru it has been issued by BBMP, now reported to be the Greater Bengaluru Authority.
terms.legal: Not checked against an official source.

terms.plain: The digital khata on the e-Aasthi portal. Reported to be needed for registration and plan approval in Bengaluru, which was NOT confirmed on an official page.
A-khata is reported to mean fully approved. B-khata is reported to mean recorded for tax but with planning gaps. There is a B-to-A regularisation scheme reported with changing fees.
Reported to have replaced BBMP on 2 September 2025.
Bedroom, hall, kitchen. A 3 BHK has three bedrooms plus a hall and a kitchen.
terms.legal: Industry term, no legal definition used here.

terms.plain: Carpet area plus walls and a share of common areas such as lobbies and the clubhouse. Larger than carpet area, so a per-sq-ft price quoted on it is not comparable with carpet-area pricing.
terms.legal: Industry term. RERA sells by carpet area.

terms.plain: Under construction means not yet complete. Ready to move means built and, ideally, with an occupancy certificate.
The state government's minimum value used to calculate stamp duty and registration charges.
Taxes and fees paid to register a sale deed. Karnataka's registration system is called Kaveri.

terms.term: Planning authorities in Bengaluru (BDA, BMRDA, GBA)
terms.plain: Bodies that plan land use and sanction layouts and buildings in and around Bengaluru. Which one applies depends on the location.
terms.legal: Not checked. Escalate any approval claim.

terms.plain: Changing agricultural land to non-agricultural use before building. Current Karnataka rules were NOT researched.
A broker or sales partner who brings buyers to a developer for a commission. Under RERA they are real estate agents and must register.
Marketing an unregistered project can mean a penalty up to 10% of the project cost (and prison for continued violation). Other breaches, including advertisement rules, up to 5%.
